responses.text: You're the one making a name for yourself among the troops, aren't you? What is it you need?
Ah, the vaunted hero of the Legion. What can I do for you?
You've been quite difficult to predict, my friend. I hope I can sway you more solidly to the Legion's way of thinking.
Caesar is not fond of loose cannons like yourself. I sincerely hope you change your ways before something drastic must occur.
I've been warned about you. You are perilously close to making an enemy of Caesar, and that is not wise.
I understand you've been invited to meet with Caesar. You should be aware of the honor you've been granted.
If we weren't in Khan territory I would kill you where you stand. Caesar will be avenged!
Caesar's death was tragic, but do not think that it will break the Legion's resolve.
Caesar's veterans will arrive from Arizona soon, and there will be no stopping our victory.
Greetings in the name of {KAI-zar} Caesar.
I understand you've been talking to the Great Khans about breaking their oaths to great Caesar. I would call that... unwise.
What more do you want?
My name is Karl. Glorious Caesar has sent me as an emissary to the Great Khans as a token of our alliance.
{Shifty, doesn't really believe what he's saying.} They're a tribe of fine warriors, with many proud traditions and a glorious history. They will be worthy additions to the Legion.
[FAILED] Alas, my first loyalty is to Caesar, and a soldier cannot have two masters.

topics.prompt: What do you think of the Great Khans?

responses.text: [SUCCEEDED] Join? Oh, no, I simply couldn't. That is... I'm {choking on this, REALLY hates to say it} not worthy of such an honor.

topics.prompt: I've been wondering why you don't petition the Khans for membership as a show of allegiance.

responses.text: You've been a persistent annoyance. I had hoped to avoid this, but it seems I have no choice but to deal with you myself.
Well-spoken.

topics.prompt: Let's get this over with then.

responses.text: Noooooooo!

topics.prompt: Send your whole damned Legion if you want - I'll water the desert with their blood.

responses.text: [SUCCEEDED] {Getting annoyed} Of course I am! {Smoother, recovering} That is to say, Caesar has many fine warriors, and I wouldn't wish to compare them to the Great Khans.

topics.prompt: But surely a warrior in service of glorious Caesar is the equal of any tribe's finest?

responses.text: [FAILED] You insult our hosts, where I wouldn't dare to. You might want to watch that talk around Papa Khan.

topics.prompt: Wow, you're not worthy to join a scruffy tribe of has-been desert raiders? You must suck.

responses.text: [SUCCEEDED] {Furious} Enough! How dare you compare Caesar's finest to this tribe of savages? The mightiest Great Khan is scarcely a match for a Legion recruit!
The Burned Man would leave their mightiest shitting themselves in terror! I would... {Beat, realizing what he's just done} Uhhh, that is....

topics.prompt: Because you know they'd come up lacking?

responses.text: [FAILED] Win? I wasn't aware we were competing.
You motherless bastard. You'll pay for this!

topics.prompt: Interesting opinion, Karl. I wonder what Papa Khan will say about this.

responses.text: In exchange for great Caesar's promise of all the lands west of New Vegas, the Khans have agreed to fight alongside the Legion when the time comes.
I am one of the {Fru-men-TAR-ee-eye} frumentarii: it is my duty to scout the Wastes in Caesar's name and make contact with any tribes that might serve a useful purpose.
You might say I'm somewhere between a scout and an ambassador. I'm assigned here as part of the alliance between the Legion and the Great Khans.

topics.prompt: What's your role in Caesar's Legion?

responses.text: Though they have been cruelly oppressed by the NCR, the Khans remain great warriors. {Choking on this a little; he's lying and it galls him} The Legion is honored to have such allies in battle.

topics.prompt: What does the Legion want with the Great Khans?

responses.text: Speak, then.
Yes. Goodbye.
